hints.title: Multi-Argument Reference Tree Caching
hints.text: Caching function results where parameters include arbitrary objects and primitive types requires establishing an argument tree rather than stringifying keys.

hints.title: Trie Structure Over Argument References
hints.text: Model arguments as a sequence of path transitions in a tree. Each node in the tree holds transitions to next argument nodes using map instances keyed by argument identities.

hints.title: Trie Node Traversal Blueprint
hints.text: Maintain root map and a unique symbol marker for leaf values. In wrapper(...args): traverse node starting from root; for each arg, look up in current map; if absent, create new Map; at end of args, check if leaf symbol exists; if not, compute fn(...args) and store. Return stored leaf value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: number of arguments per call
complexity.notes: Lookup and insertion in the argument trie takes O(K) average time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: JSON.stringify serializes distinct object references with identical contents into the same string and throws errors on circular references.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map keys preserve distinct object identity references by address.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling heterogeneous types including objects and primitives without collision.

solutions.approach: Argument-Path Tree with Identity Maps and Symbol Result Storage
